title: Handoff Curves: Initial Selection, Later Handoff, and Supervision Targets in Multi-turn LLM Routing
abstract: arXiv:2610.15993v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how initial model selection, later handoff, and training targets affect success and cost in LLM tasks that span multiple turns. We compare several router architectures using handoff curves, which record task success and cost as the handoff step changes. Our dataset contains 34,204 complete executions of three Qwen models across BFCL, MultiWOZ, and $\tau$-retail, providing offline supervision for routing decisions. In our primary comparison, with Qwen3.5 35B-A3B as the starting model, allowing a later handoff does not establish an improvement in utility over initial selection on BFCL or MultiWOZ, and increases cost on BFCL across a range of cost weights. Changing the supervision targets improves router performance on both our dataset and TwinRouterBench. On our dataset, replacing noisy training success curves with monotone fits raises success by 0.2 to 4.1 percentage points at the same cost across the reported operating points. O

translated_title: 交接曲线：多轮LLM路由中的初始选择、后续交接与监督目标
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在跨越多轮的LLM任务中，初始模型选择、后续交接和训练目标如何影响任务成功率与成本。我们使用交接曲线来比较多种路由器架构，该曲线记录了随着交接步骤变化时的任务成功率与成本。我们的数据集包含三个Qwen模型在BFCL、MultiWOZ和τ-retail上的34,204次完整执行，为路由决策提供离线监督。在我们的主要比较中，以Qwen3.5 35B-A3B作为起始模型时，允许后续交接在BFCL或MultiWOZ上并未带来相对初始选择的效用提升，并且在一系列成本权重下增加了BFCL上的成本。改变监督目标在我们自己的数据集和TwinRouterBench上都提升了路由器的性能。在我们的数据集上，用单调拟合替代带噪声的训练成功率曲线，在相同成本下，于报告的各个工作点上将成功率提高了0.2至4.1个百分点。
tldr: 该研究通过交接曲线分析多轮LLM路由，发现引入后续交接未必优于初始模型选择，而用单调拟合替代噪声成功率曲线作为监督目标可在相同成本下将路由成功率提升0.2至4.1个百分点。
